description.en: 🫐Bemly_'s o-chinchin🐳

A local DeepSeek Harness plugin (package `dsh-friction-drive`, repository `Zbcc0826/better-dsh`, not published to npm). It records tool failures, same-argument retries, and results with truncation markers in the current session. Once crossed, the next direct call does not run and waits for the user to choose via `friction_choose`, and the user can also pause the session. Replacement tools and compiled procedures are installed only after user approval, while original tool definitions stay unchanged. `dsh-friction-drive` registers only these 10 tools: `friction_status`, `friction_choose`, `friction_pause`, `propose_quality_loop`, `record_quality_critique`, `record_quality_plan`, `propose_tool_goal`, `apply_tool_change`, `restore_tool_definition`, and `propose_compiled_procedure`. The same bundle also installs `dsh-friction-demo`, which registers 3 sample tools (`ledger_lookup`, `fx_convert`, `window_overlap`); they are sample tools only, not a ledger product. This repository is Zbcc0826/better-dsh, not pgmi-builds/better-dsh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地插件（包名 `dsh-friction-drive`，仓库 `Zbcc0826/better-dsh`，不发布到 npm）。插件记录当前会话里工具的失败、同参数重试和带截断标记的结果；过线后下一次直接调用不执行，等待用户通过 `friction_choose` 选择，也可由用户暂停当前会话。替代工具和沉淀程序只在用户同意后安装，原工具定义不改。`dsh-friction-drive` 只注册这 10 个工具：`friction_status`、`friction_choose`、`friction_pause`、`propose_quality_loop`、`record_quality_critique`、`record_quality_plan`、`propose_tool_goal`、`apply_tool_change`、`restore_tool_definition`、`propose_compiled_procedure`。同一个 bundle 还会装上 `dsh-friction-demo`，注册 3 个示例工具：`ledger_lookup`、`fx_convert`、`window_overlap`，它们只是示例，不是账本产品。这个仓库是 Zbcc0826/better-dsh，不是 pgmi-builds/better-dsh。

description.zh: 内置会话复盘技能，并在右侧栏看板聚合所有未归档会话的卡片。

description.en: Compute a figure's printed font size from your page's text width before you export it, then verify three things per file — printed size, effective resolution, and pixel width — and pick a chart type that matches the message. Ships a style module, a read-only verifier, an overlap audit, CFD panel conventions, and 19 reproducible recipes rendered from synthetic data.

description.zh: 将 DSH 与本机 Claude Code、Codex 和 Antigravity 会话相连，支持进度关注、双向通知与跨 Agent 任务接力。

description.en: Shows a Windows toast with Allow and Deny buttons when DSH asks for approval, with the reason rewritten by a model into one plain sentence; clicking the toast body brings DSH forward and hands the decision to the in-app card.

description.en: Durable background task templates for DSH: define a task as one to ten ordered steps, then run it by hand or from a native Schedule entry. Steps are executed by the calling agent in its own authorized context - there is no resident worker. Each execution becomes its own TaskRun with a frozen template snapshot, persisted per-step status and progress, a heartbeat and execution token, a failure record naming the failing step, and a queryable run history. Failed, interrupted and blocked runs are recovered by creating a new run that carries completed steps over and resumes at the first unfinished one; a step that may have produced side effects needs explicit confirmation before retry, and records that cannot be proven finished are never replayed automatically. Records live in a StorageDomain rather than memory, so they survive restart; a duplicated schedule delivery cannot start a second execution, and overlapping runs are bounded per task and per Session. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 (desktop) with Node 22+; scheduling uses the host native Schedule and is unavailable when that service is not mounted, while manual runs keep working. Tasks are private to the Session that created them; the board UI is meant for a single local user and does not claim multi-user isolation, because the host does not authenticate plugin HTTP routes. Registers 14 task_* tools and reuses the host schedule, agent and tool permissions instead of replacing them. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 的可复用后台任务模板：把任务写成 1 到 10 个有序步骤，既可以手动执行，也可以挂到原生定时任务上。步骤由调用方 Agent 在它自己的授权上下文里执行，不存在常驻 Worker。每次执行都是一条独立的 TaskRun，带冻结的模板快照、持久化的步骤状态与进度、心跳与执行凭证、记录失败步骤的错误信息，以及可查询的运行历史。失败、中断、阻塞的运行通过新建一次运行来恢复，已完成步骤会结转、从第一个未完成步骤继续；可能有副作用的步骤必须先由用户确认才能重试，无法确认结果时绝不自动重放。记录存放在 StorageDomain 而不是内存里，重启后仍在；同一时间点的重复定时投递不会重复启动，并发按任务与会话双重限额。已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3（桌面版）与 Node 22+ 上验证；定时复用宿主原生 Schedule，未挂载该服务时定时不可用而手动执行照常。任务只对创建它的会话可见；看板按本机单用户设计，不宣称多用户隔离，因为宿主不对插件的 HTTP 路由做认证。注册 14 个 task_* 工具，复用宿主既有的调度、Agent 与工具权限。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Ask a side question while the main task keeps running: the answer stays in a popup above the composer, and the question is grounded in the running turn's live streamed reasoning and tool calls, the most recent finished tool calls, and the completed history.
description.zh: 主任务继续运行的同时发一句侧问：答案只出现在输入框上方的弹窗里，参考的上下文包括当前这一轮正在流式生成的思考与工具调用、最近完成的工具调用，以及已完成的对话历史。

description.en: Opens file references from DSH chat at the exact line: click a path to choose the right sidebar or any detected desktop editor, including IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, Trae, Qoder, CodeBuddy, Sublime Text and Typora. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天里按行打开文件引用：点击路径即可选右侧栏或本机已装编辑器，支持 IntelliJ IDEA、VS Code、Trae、Qoder、CodeBuddy、Sublime Text 与 Typora。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Multi-agent workbench for DSH — 19 role templates, a team panel with task board and per-agent usage, plus a codenow tool that lets the lead agent plan, dispatch, review and deliver.

Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

Reuses the login state of a Marvis client already signed in on this machine and refreshes its short-lived access token automatically, so no API key is needed and the client need not stay running. Also detects the gateway rule that rejects a system prompt opening with a generic assistant identity sentence, and rewrites it at the boundary.
description.zh: 把腾讯马维斯背后的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 V4 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4、混元 Hy3 与 HY-Vision。复用本机已登录 Marvis 客户端的登录态并自动续期短命的 access token，因此不用填 API Key，客户端也不必常驻。另外会识别网关「system 开头是通用助手身份句就判非法」的规则，并在出口处改写掉。

description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的只读、限量、留痕查数窗口（SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL），含 schema 树、可排序结果表、CSV 导出与须人确认的自然语言问数。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Portable memory library for DSH: memory files, verbatim daily logs, and a wiki of accumulated understanding that survives restarts and machine changes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的可移植记忆库：记忆文件、按天留底的原话、跨机器搬家的认识层。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Deep-blue cockpit HUD for the Web UI: a collapsible panel with live session economy (prompt and completion tokens, smoothed tok/s, context occupancy with threshold colours), a typed tool trajectory that takes over the assistant-step renderer, a self-contained Markdown renderer, and a data-flow gallery with token rhythm, a context curve and the thinking/execution stream. Also applies one deep-blue theme token layer plus a generated starfield, and uninstalling restores the original UI exactly.
description.zh: 深蓝驾驶舱 HUD：右下角可折叠面板显示会话经济（入/出 token、平滑 tok/s、上下文占用与阈值色）；接管 assistant-step 渲染器把思考逐字打出、思考块可折叠、工具调用可展开，正文走自建 Markdown 渲染器；另有数据流弹窗（token 节奏柱、上下文曲线、思考与执行流）。同时用一层 theme token 把整套界面切成深蓝并铺星空，卸载即完全还原。

description.en: Always-on writing-style section appended to the system prompt (1449 characters: six principles plus banned-phrase, banned sentence-pattern and English-mirror lists) that steers replies towards a terse engineering register, plus two tools — humanize_check scans text against 58 rules (45 Chinese, 13 English, eight groups) and reports hits with dash, bold and sentence-length statistics, and humanize_rules returns the long-form lists for direct, GPT-style, DeepSeek-style or 31 editing checkpoints.
description.zh: 常驻 system prompt 的写作风格段（1449 字符：六条原则、必删套话、必拆句式和英文镜像清单），把回复压成直白工程口吻；另配两个工具：humanize_check 按 58 条规则（中文 45、英文 13、八组）扫描文本并报告命中和破折号、加粗、句长统计，humanize_rules 取回 direct、GPT 腔、DeepSeek 腔或 31 个编辑检查点的全文清单。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar and home hero branding with one of 13 AI product logo presets, a custom SVG/image and label, or nothing at all, with separate toggles for the sidebar mark, the hero mark, the blank-home whale animation and monochrome icons.
description.zh: 把侧边栏与首页标题的品牌标识换成 13 款 AI 产品 Logo 预设、自定义 SVG/图片与文字，或完全隐藏，并可分别控制侧边栏图标、首页图标、空白首页鲸鱼动画与单色图标。

description.en: A PyFluent operating procedure for ANSYS Fluent on Windows, distilled from real production runs: startup handshake, setup order, session state-machine traps, time-step and Courant judgement, long runs with checkpoint and resume, VOF, multiphase and non-Newtonian setups, UDS plus UDF compilation, result reading from .dat.h5, and twelve environment traps with the exact error strings that precede them.
description.zh: Windows 下的 PyFluent 实操规程，来自真实生产算例：启动握手、设置顺序、会话状态机陷阱、时间步与 Courant 判定、长跑与断点续算、VOF 与多相及非牛顿设置、UDS 与 UDF 编译、.dat.h5 结果读取，以及十二条环境坑与它们的原始报错。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness approved mouse and keyboard control, window binding, screen capture, and an optional Live2D desktop display for playing windowed games.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受审批的键鼠操作、窗口绑定、屏幕截图，以及可选的 Live2D 桌面显示，用于操作窗口化游戏。

description.en: Knowledge workbench for game designers: typed memories and knowledge nodes in one relational graph, with versioned evidence, protected conventions the AI cannot overwrite, and task-scoped recall. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向游戏策划的知识工作台：把带类型的记忆与知识对象连成一张关系网，提供版本与证据留痕、AI 改不动的固有约定保护，以及按任务分层的召回。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Accelerated GitHub download manager for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a download panel in the sidebar and a github_download tool the agent can call to fetch GitHub files, release assets, source archives and gists through gh-proxy into the workspace, with progress, pause/resume, multi-channel link conversion and a download-history list.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 加速下载管理插件。在侧栏提供下载管理面板，并向 Agent 提供 github_download 工具，可通过 gh-proxy 把 GitHub 文件、Release 资产、源码归档与 Gist 下载到工作区，支持进度显示、暂停续传、多通道链接转换与下载历史列表。

description.en: Search every DSH conversation across all workspaces and all records. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 跨所有工作区搜索 DSH 的全部历史对话与记录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A workday countdown under the message composer. It shows the time left, today's progress, an ahead reminder (30 minutes by default, adjustable 0-120), an overtime timer once the workday ends, and a weekend label. Hours and the reminder are edited on the settings page; values stay in this browser. Zero dependencies, no build step, no network requests.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方显示下班倒计时：剩余时间、今日进度、提前提醒（默认提前 30 分钟，可在设置页改为 0–120）、下班后自动切换为加班计时、周末单独提示。上下班时间与提醒在设置页中修改；配置仅保存在本浏览器。零依赖、无构建步骤、不发起网络请求。

description.en: A theme-independent floating 1984 Macintosh companion for DeepSeek Harness with animated CRT states, ClaraCore-inspired InnerLife proactive thoughts, Mini DSH sidecar agent, retro CLI Terminal, flip Note Pad, Floppy Disk Markdown/PNG export, Alarm Clock, MacPaint Lite, and Minesweeper.
description.zh: Hello '84（你好 84）：在 DeepSeek Harness 角落养一台活着的 1984 Macintosh，不绑定任何主题，支持多态复古屏保、InnerLife 自主琢磨冒泡、双模 Mini DSH 副脑、复古命令行终端、翻页便签、软盘 Markdown/长图导出、闹钟、MacPaint 与扫雷。

description.en: Shrinks the first session-history page so an old session's transcript paints sooner instead of rendering every turn at once.
description.zh: 缩小首次会话历史分页，打开旧会话时更快显示对话内容，而不是一次性渲染全部回合。

description.en: Nascent Soul Sea (元婴识海, dsh-hncsd) turns every first-level folder under a local root into one star of a galaxy panel in the DSH sidebar: colour encodes the subfolder count and size encodes the session count. The scan only reads the local root it is given and opens no network connection.
description.zh: 元婴识海（dsh-hncsd）：把本地根目录下的每个一级子目录映射成侧栏星系面板里的一颗星，颜色编码子目录数、大小编码会话数；扫描只读取所指定的本机目录，扫描过程不发起网络请求。

description.en: Encrypted local vault for model API keys. Import keys.txt, check provider balances and subscription quotas, write providers into the DSH model config with one click, and open official top-up pages.
description.zh: 加密保存各家模型 API Key，导入 keys.txt、查看余额与订阅额度、一键写入 DSH 模型配置，并跳转官方充值页。

description.en: Local document reader for DeepSeek Harness with PDF, Office, EPUB and Markdown support, selection actions, region questions, page screenshots and instruction-based editing.
description.zh: DSH 里的本地文档阅读器，支持 PDF、Office、EPUB、Markdown，划词翻译/解释/总结、框选提问、页面截图与按指令编辑。

description.en: A centred call popup and a draggable row of session chips for DeepSeek Harness. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加屏幕中间的呼叫弹窗，和一排可拖动的会话小方块。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A focused coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: intent-first scope, first-principles root-cause fixes, native parallel tool surface, and verified delivery — installed as a hot-pluggable bundle.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的专项编码 Agent 预设：意图对齐、第一性原理根因修复、原生并行工具面与改后实测交付，以组合包形式热插拔安装。

description.en: Liquid-glass surfaces, an animated gradient background and interactive water ripples for DSH 0.2.2, with lifecycle cleanup and device-local settings.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.2 的液态玻璃表面、渐变流动背景与交互水波，支持停用清理和设备本地设置。

description.en: Local DeepSeek Harness plugin (not published to npm) built from Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki gist. Raw sources go into raw/ and are never rewritten. Pages update only from validated patches after user approval, and writes return NOT_APPROVED without hanging if no approval UI is present. Registers only 8 tools: wiki_status, wiki_parsers, wiki_read, wiki_ingest, wiki_query, wiki_graph, wiki_lint, and wiki_llm. Contradictions keep both sides on pages and in query results. wiki_graph walks 0 to 4 hops along page relations (optionally filtered by predicate) without calling a model; both relations and source hashes live on pages. Long sources split by headings and tables up to 8 segments per ingest with no resume parameter: unread text is noted on the source index page, wiki_lint reports PARTIAL, re-ingesting the full text still processes only the first 8 segments, and the unread tail must be ingested as a separate source. Built-in parsers cover images (pixels only, no OCR), Markdown, plain text, JSON, CSV, and HTML. PDF, Office, audio, and video return NEED_EXTERNAL_PARSER and can connect via the llm-wiki.parsers service or wiki_ingest's parsed parameter.
description.zh: 基于 Andrej Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 说明实现的 DeepSeek Harness 本地插件（不发布到 npm）。原料存入 raw/ 后不再修改。页面只在用户批准后按校验过的补丁更新；没有审批界面时写入返回 NOT_APPROVED，不挂起。仅注册 8 个工具：wiki_status、wiki_parsers、wiki_read、wiki_ingest、wiki_query、wiki_graph、wiki_lint、wiki_llm。页面可记录矛盾的另一面，查询时保留两边。wiki_graph 不调用模型，沿页面上的 relations 走 0 到 4 跳（可用 predicate 筛选一种谓语）；关系和来源哈希都写在页面上。长材料按章节和表格切分，每次最多摄入 8 段且没有续读参数：未纳入的文字标在来源目录页上，wiki_lint 对不完整页报告 PARTIAL，用同一份全文再次摄入仍只展开前 8 段，未读尾巴需另作一份新材料再摄入。内建解析器支持图像（只留像素，不编造 OCR）、Markdown、纯文本、JSON、CSV、HTML；PDF、Office、音视频返回 NEED_EXTERNAL_PARSER，可通过服务 llm-wiki.parsers 或 wiki_ingest 的 parsed 参数接入。

description.en: Preview images and videos in chat and browse saved file snapshots shared across sessions in the same local project.
description.zh: 在聊天中预览图片和视频，并浏览同一本地项目中跨会话共享的文件快照。

description.en: Rebuilds the composer model picker as a source-first menu: the first level lists the model sources enlarged, each with an initial badge, its model count and which model is current, and the models of a source open one level down, with a search box once a source has more than six models and a row per model showing its reasoning-effort count or its description. Reasoning effort is its own row on the first level, or a third level for models that carry efforts. It occupies the conversation.input.model seat at priority -20 and reads the same catalog as the /model command through the modelDirectories service, so the two agree on what is selectable; a failed registration logs and hands the seat back to the shipped picker.
description.zh: 把输入框上的模型选择器改成「先选来源、再选模型」的菜单：第一层放大列出模型来源，每个带首字母徽标、模型数量和当前模型，点进去才是该来源的模型；模型超过 6 个时出现搜索框，每行显示推理档数或模型描述。推理强度在第一层是独立一行，对带推理档的模型则展开为第三层。它以 priority -20 占用 conversation.input.model 座位，通过 modelDirectories 服务读与 /model 命令相同的目录，两者对「能选什么」保持一致；注册失败时打印日志并把座位交还原生选择器。

description.en: Native Mol* sidebar viewer with Agent tools for molecular structures, surfaces, measurements, and playback of existing MD trajectories.
description.zh: 原生 Mol* 分子侧栏，支持 Agent 控制结构查看、表面渲染、几何测量及已有 MD 轨迹播放。

description.en: A sidebar widget that tracks earnings in real time against the configured monthly salary and work hours, with a countdown to the end of the workday, goal progress and a hide-the-amount toggle.
description.zh: 侧栏小组件：按配置的月薪与工作时间实时累计收入，带下班倒计时、目标进度，金额可一键隐藏。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that runs a software-delivery workflow: it sizes each task into quick, standard or deep, bundles 22 skills for requirement questioning, spec writing, ticket breakdown, implementation, review, verification and handoff, and adds a turn guard that requires real verification evidence and stops a repeated fix after two failed attempts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 代理预设：把任务分为快速、标准、深入三档，内置 22 个技能覆盖需求追问、写规格、拆工单、实现、评审、验证与交接，并带轮次守卫——改完必须给出真实验证证据，同一修法失败两次就停下重新核对前提。

description.en: Voice-clone provider for the dsh-pet desktop pet: registers a SiliconFlow CosyVoice2 voice so the pet speaks its lines in a voice cloned from a short recording of your own. Requires a SiliconFlow API key and a 10 to 30 second reference clip.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠用的克隆音色：注册一个基于硅基流动 CosyVoice2 的音色，让桌宠用从你自己的短录音复刻出的声音念台词。需要硅基流动 API Key 和一段 10 至 30 秒的参考录音。

description.en: Render PlantUML code blocks in DSH conversations and the built-in Markdown file preview using a local command, a JAR, or a configured PlantUML server, with live editing and diagram export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话和内建 Markdown 文件预览中渲染 PlantUML 代码块，支持本机命令、JAR 或自选 PlantUML 服务，以及实时编辑预览和图表导出。

description.en: Chrome page bridge for DeepSeek Harness: eight browser_* tools read DOM elements, click, type and navigate through a token-paired extension over a loopback WebSocket, so the model works on page text instead of screenshots and no DevTools port is opened.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接读 Chrome 页面：通过令牌配对的扩展在本地回环 WebSocket 上提供 8 个 browser_* 工具，按选择器或文本读元素、点击、填表、跳转，不截图，也不打开 DevTools 端口。

description.en: Generates multi-platform devlogs, 4-slide visual cards, and daily or weekly work reports from git commits with GitHub release, Playwright draft saving, image prompt generation, and 6-channel webhook delivery.
description.zh: 从本地 Git 提交自动生成多平台开发日志、四图轮播卡片与工作日报周报，支持 GitHub 发布、Playwright 草稿箱填表、生图提示词模板与六大办公渠道 Webhook 推送。

description.en: Settings page for editing DSH agent presets as a plugin tree, with per-plugin parameter forms and custom presets.
description.zh: 在设置页以插件树编辑 DSH Agent 预设，为每个插件提供参数表单，并支持自定义预设。

description.en: Brings platform.qianwenai.com into DSH: Token Plan and pay-as-you-go providers, a model catalog with pricing, credits and quota readout, and thinking-mode controls. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 platform.qianwenai.com 接入 DSH：Token Plan 与按量付费双通道、模型目录与定价、Credits 额度查询与思考模式控制。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reviews research and everyday task answers against user instructions, tool results and delivered files, with quoted evidence beneath each answer.
description.zh: 对照用户要求、工具执行记录和交付文件，审查科研与日常任务的回答，并在原回答下展示问题和证据原文。

description.en: Ordered multi-provider web search chain that tries your saved vendors in turn, aggregating their free quotas into one high-quota, always-available search tool with per-entry proxy egress.
description.zh: 有序多厂商搜索降级链：按保存顺序逐个尝试、失败或无结果才降级，把各厂商免费额度聚合为一个高额度、始终可用的 web_search，支持条目级代理出站与 PAC 沙箱。

description.en: Trim a DSH session log segment by segment, with an automatic backup and a host-validated write. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按段修剪 DSH 会话日志（可勾选、可反悔），写盘前自动备份并用宿主校验器验过。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Permanently deletes a Session from the sidebar: the row archive button becomes a delete action with an in-app confirmation, and the Host stops live work then removes the saved history after checking the directory belongs only to that Session.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：把会话行上的归档按钮换成删除操作，弹窗内二次确认后由 Host 停止运行中的工作，校验目录只属于该会话，再删除其保存的记录。

description.en: Repaints DeepSeek Harness in lavender frosted glass — a moonlit key-art wallpaper behind translucent sidebar, conversation and composer surfaces, a draggable lab-coat pet in the bottom-right corner, and a portrait brand mark in place of the top-left logo.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 换成薰衣草紫磨砂玻璃——月夜画面壁纸透过半透明的侧边栏、会话区与输入框，右下角是可以拖着走的白大褂宠物，左上角 logo 换成头像标记。

description.en: Scales the DSH sidebar text, row heights and icons together from 11 to 16 pixels, with a - / + size step in the sidebar More menu, on its own panel page and on the plugin page. The conversation keeps its own font size.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏的文字、行高和图标一起按 11–16px 等比缩放，侧栏「更多」、插件自带的面板页和插件页里都能用 − / + 调；会话正文仍用自己的字号。

description.en: Detect conflicts between installed skills: group them by capability and separate compatible overlap from real conflicts.
description.zh: 检测已安装 skill 之间的冲突：按能力分组，区分「同类型但不冲突」与「互相冲突」。

description.en: A sidebar switchboard for the skills you own: list them, flip model or user invocation on and off, search the bodies, check and one-click fix spec problems, edit SKILL.md, import a folder or zip, move a skill between roots, tag it, and restore anything you deleted. Toggles are written back to the skill frontmatter and picked up without a restart.
description.zh: 左侧栏的技能开关台：列出你自己装的技能，逐个拨动「模型调用 / 用户调用」，全文搜索技能正文，按规范检查并一键修复，直接编辑 SKILL.md，导入文件夹或 zip，在用户/通用/项目三个根之间移动，打标签，删除后还能从回收站恢复。开关写回技能 frontmatter，无需重启即生效。

description.en: A DSH meta-provider that routes requests across configured models and accounts with smart routing, account pooling, cost statistics, and layered health management—neutral by default, with cost-first as an opt-in strategy.
description.zh: 一个在已配置模型与账号间智能路由的 DSH 元提供商，提供账号池、成本统计与三层健康管理，默认中立，省钱优先为可选项。

description.en: A read-only badge in the subagent composer showing the model and reasoning effort that subagent session actually runs on, read from its own model-selection and request-header events.
description.zh: 子智能体会话输入框旁的只读徽章，显示该会话实际使用的模型与思考程度，取自它自己的模型选择与请求头事件。

description.en: Tag-based long-term memory for dsh agents: entries live in a plain 9-column CSV that can be opened and edited by hand, with three JSONL ledgers recording every write, read and tidy, plus an automatic backup before any library change. Project and agent are filled by the program from the session working directory and the bound identity, so the model only decides free tags and must ask the user for a name on first use in an unbound session. Recall hard-filters on project, agent and status before scoring, so other agents entries are invisible by isolation rather than by low score, then applies two vetoes (entry ratio above 0.5, query ratio at least 0.15) so a passing score still cannot return noise. A stability ladder promotes an entry to stable only after three verified uses with no wrong answer, and any wrong demotes it to volatile. 10 tools, a web UI for browsing and editing, no network calls, no embeddings, no API keys.
description.zh: 给 dsh 智能体的标签化长期记忆：条目存在一份可直接用编辑器打开修改的 9 列 CSV 里，写入、读取、整理三本 JSONL 台账记录每一次操作，改库前自动备份。项目与智能体由程序从会话工作目录和已绑定身份填充，模型只决定自由标签，未绑定身份的会话首次使用时必须向用户询问名字。召回先按项目、智能体、状态硬筛再打分，跨智能体条目靠隔离不可见而非分数低，另有两道否决（条目命中率须大于 0.5、query 命中率须不低于 0.15），过线也不会返回噪声。稳定性阶梯需三次验证通过且无错答才升为稳定，出现错答即降为易变。10 个工具、可浏览与编辑的网页界面，无网络请求、无向量、无 API 密钥。

description.en: A theme-independent retro chrome toaster companion for DeepSeek Harness inspired by 1989 After Dark Flying Toasters — roasts while AI works, pops golden buttered toast on completion, smokes burnt toast on errors, with a 1-5 doneness Pomodoro dial, toast tray Markdown export, and Flying Toasters screensaver mode.
description.zh: DSH Toaster（吐司机）：致敬 1989 After Dark 飞翔烤面包机的独立复古挂件——AI 干活按杆烘烤、完成叮一声弹金黄吐司、卡审批半熟抖动、报错冒黑烟弹焦炭，内置 1~5 档番茄钟、涂黄油收藏装盘导出与全屏放飞彩蛋。

description.en: Hands the model a tool catalog on each step, lets it load only the tools it needs with tool_pick, and narrows the visible tool set accordingly to reduce per-step tool schema tokens.
description.zh: 每步先给模型一份工具目录，由它用 tool_pick 只加载需要的工具，据此收窄本轮可见工具集，减少每步的工具定义 token 开销。

description.en: OpenCode Go usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: plan quota (rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly), local token stats, per-model cost, and one-click Go model list refresh. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 用量面板：滚动 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月三窗口套餐额度、本地 token 统计、按模型费用，以及一键刷新 Go 模型清单。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Read-only DSH sidebar listing every Git worktree on the machine by repository, with status, inline diffs and matching Codex / ZCode / DSH sessions; fetch, pull, push and AI code review only on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏只读总览本机的全部 Git 工作树，按仓库分组：状态、未推送和落后数、未提交与未推送改动的就地差异、本地分支，以及匹配到的 Codex / ZCode / DSH 会话；获取、拉取、推送和 AI 代码审查都只在你触发之后才执行。

description.en: A plan-to-run-to-verify growth workflow for DSH: a .growing/ mirror (plan, per-task retros, lessons ledger) that the repository dogfoods on itself; 28 bundled skills and 4 subagent presets, plus a portable bash guard (gate-check, task-verify, next-task, doctor) with a retro gate, ranked lesson injection, an opt-in fake-green check, and a turn-end guard that steers the turn back when the working tree moved without a successful verify stamp.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 plan→run→verify 成长型开发流程：.growing/ 镜像（计划、逐任务复盘、教训台账）由仓库自身 dogfood；内置 28 个技能与 4 个子代理预设，外加可移植 bash 守卫（gate-check、task-verify、next-task、doctor）——复盘必交门、教训排名注入、防假绿检查（opt-in），以及回合收尾守卫：工作区有改动却没有成功 verify 印记时打回本回合。

description.en: Stata for agent workflows: runs Stata code and do-files, returns coefficients with standard errors, 95% intervals and omitted terms, blocks destructive commands before they reach Stata, and moves imputation or bootstrap runs into background processes.
description.zh: 让 agent 直接跑 Stata：执行代码与 do 文件，回归结果读成系数、标准误、95% 区间与被省略项；erase、shell 这类命令在到达 Stata 前就被拦下；插补、bootstrap 这类长任务转后台进程跑完，不再被 Stata 忙占掐断。

description.en: Activity-aware workspace lock for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled (weekly preset or Cron) and manual screen locking that waits for 90s UI idle and lets tracked DSH agents and background jobs finish before unloading managed Host .cjs plugins; encrypts imported plugin source (up to 128 KiB, compiled in memory) and SMTP credentials with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM; unlocks with a master password and six-digit email verification code (QQ Mail preset or custom SMTP), with 15-day lock history.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的活动感知工作区锁屏插件：支持定时（按周预设或 Cron）与手动锁屏，等待 90 秒界面空闲并在 DSH 跟踪的 Agent 与后台作业完成后卸载托管 Host .cjs 插件；使用 Argon2id + AES-256-GCM 加密导入的插件源码（上限 128 KiB，内存编译执行）与 SMTP 授权码；通过主密码与六位邮件验证码（内置 QQ 邮箱预设及自定义 SMTP）解锁，保留最近 15 天锁定日志。

description.en: Play mp4, m4v, webm, ogv and mov files inside the DeepSeek Harness Sidebar document preview with native playback controls, instead of the unsupported-format message.
description.zh: 在侧边栏文档预览里直接播放 mp4、m4v、webm、ogv、mov，替代“该格式文件暂无法预览”。

description.en: Agent skill that registers one chemometrics skill and runs a reviewer-grade modelling pipeline on spectra and tabular regression: grouped nested cross-validation, Y-randomization permutation tests, four applicability-domain checks, publication figures and a draft Methods paragraph, backed by a 6-stage Python CLI and a 55-item environment self-check.
description.zh: 化学计量学 agent skill：面向光谱与表格数据的回归与分类，做分组嵌套交叉验证、Y 随机化置换检验、四类适用域判定，产出论文级图表与 Methods 草稿；底层是 6 阶段 Python 命令行与 55 项环境自检。

description.en: Computer Use for a Wayland Linux desktop: screenshots through the XDG desktop portal, the AT-SPI accessibility tree, and pointer and keyboard events written straight to /dev/uinput, exposed to the model as mcp__linux__* tools together with clipboard, process, gsettings and notification helpers, plus a host-side doctor tool and an opt-in AI unlock switch that is off by default.
description.zh: 让 DSH 接管 Wayland Linux 桌面：经 XDG 桌面 portal 截屏、读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树、把鼠标键盘事件直接写入 /dev/uinput，并以 mcp__linux__* 工具连同剪贴板、进程、gsettings 与通知一起交给模型，附带宿主机诊断工具和默认关闭的可选解锁开关。

description.en: Computer Use for Ubuntu / GNOME Wayland in DeepSeek Harness: screenshots, AT-SPI UI tree, uinput pointer/keyboard, clipboard, processes and gsettings, bridged as mcp__linux__* tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上操作 Ubuntu 桌面的手和眼：截屏、读 UI 树、控制鼠标键盘、剪贴板、进程和系统设置都能用。

description.en: Compact long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a short boot block, details retrieved on demand, writes through tools. House rules get their own budget, and after compaction it checks which constraints were lost and warns at the start of the next turn. Mood and tidy reminders plus a self-wake mechanism, all modular and removable.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的紧凑长期记忆：开机只注入一小段，细节按需检索，写回走工具。家规有独立预算；压缩后回头核对哪些约束被压丢了，丢了在下一轮开头报警。另含心情与整理提醒、主动唤醒，全部模块化可删。

description.en: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. At a fixed hour (11:00 by default) it reads the plugin market's own catalog — the same JSON the market browser uses — ranks it by real install counts and stars, and proposes two kinds of item: a concrete delta on a plugin people actually use (the original does A, this one would do B) and a direction nobody has built yet. Popularity numbers are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed, and an entry the market has not measured stays unmeasured instead of becoming zero. Every item is re-checked by pure functions before you see it: evidence has to match a pooled repository word for word, a delta that only says "improve the UX" is dropped and counted, and a title that renames the source repository is refused. Approving an item opens a new session named after it through the same host path the GUI's own "new session" button uses, and hands that session a fixed delivery contract: implement independently, never fork, tests green before publishing. The panel is a tab in the conversation view; 202 unit tests, zero runtime dependencies. Formerly dsh-daily — the package and repository are now dsh-plugin-daily. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 每日简报。到点（默认 11:00）读市场自己发布的目录——就是市场浏览器用的那份 JSON——按真实下载量与 star 排一遍，产出两类条目：对已经有人真在用的插件的具体改法（原版是 A，提案做成 B），以及生态里还没有的新方向。热度数字原样写进提示词而不是由模型猜；市场没测到的条目保持「无热门度数据」，绝不当作 0。每条在你看到之前都要过纯函数校验：证据必须逐字命中候选池里的仓库，只写「优化体验」的改法会被丢弃并计数，把标题写成原仓库名的「改名重发」会被拒。批准一条会走 GUI「新会话」用的同一条宿主路径，按项目名开一个会话，并把一份固定交付契约交给它：独立实现、不许 fork、测试全绿才发布。面板是对话视图里的一个「日报」Tab；202 个单测、零运行时依赖。原名 dsh-daily，包名与仓库现已改为 dsh-plugin-daily。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
